record.question: Chairman of the Mizoram Public Service Commission in 2019 is
record.explanation: Answer A: Rev. Zosangliana Colney. Rev. Zosangliana Colney was MPSC Chairman from October 2, 2017 to November 10, 2019, so he held the office in 2019. Reference: https://mpsc.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/08/ca1b4f00abfa2a58e17c67e13158cae4/annual-report-2023-2024.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
